shots.name: editor-main-window
shots.what: Play tab of a phone in portrait while a song plays (frozen on Em, bar 6): text with the playhead and yellow highlight, chord sheet (piano roll), player. No callouts (the Android counterpart of the desktop's hero shot).

shots.name: main-play-labeled
shots.page: getting_started: The Main Window; interface: Edit and Play
shots.what: Play tab of a phone in portrait while a song plays (frozen on Em, bar 6): app bar, text with the playhead and yellow highlight, chord sheet (piano roll), player. Callouts: 1 drawer, 2 title, 3 Edit/Play tabs, 4 Save, 6 text, 7 player, 8 chord sheet (5 is the ribbon, only in Edit).

shots.name: main-edit-labeled
shots.page: getting_started: The Main Window; interface: The Edit Ribbon
shots.what: Edit tab of a phone in portrait: app bar, Edit ribbon, editable text. Callouts: 1 drawer, 2 title, 3 Edit/Play tabs, 4 Save, 5 Edit ribbon, 6 text.

shots.name: player-labeled
shots.page: interface: The Player; getting_started: Playing Your First Chord / Adjusting the Tempo
shots.what: The player alone while playing, metronome on and speed 125% (badge 1.25x). Callouts: 1 song pill, 2 Voicing (greyed while playing), 3 Instrument, 4 back to start, 5 play/pause, 6 metronome, 7 speed, 8 chord sheet button, 9 status line.

shots.name: edit-ribbon
shots.what: The Edit ribbon on a phone: Undo, Redo, Insert, Transpose, Identify, AB/Do, Convert, and the › chevron (more to the right).

shots.name: notation-toggle
shots.page: introduction: Multiple Notation Systems; writing_chords: Switching Notations
shots.what: Close-up of the AB/Do notation switch and the Convert button in the Edit ribbon.

shots.name: editor-colours
shots.what: Edit tab text showing every colour: purple directives, a red invalid directive ({tempo: fast}), a grey comment, blue underlined chords and a grey underlined non-chord (Gsus5).

shots.name: playhead
shots.page: interface: The Playhead; playback: Playing from the Cursor
shots.what: Play tab text with the playhead (primary-coloured bar and triangle) before the Em chord.

shots.name: song-defaults
shots.page: interface: The Player; getting_started: Adjusting the Tempo; playback: The Status Bar
shots.what: Song defaults sheet (tap the song pill): Tempo set by {bpm: 90} in the song (read-only, with Edit), Time signature and Key as editable defaults, Write into song, Done.

shots.name: voicing-sheet
shots.page: playback: Voicing Options; fretted, piano, ensembles: How to Change Voicing; settings: Voicings
shots.what: Voicing sheet: Piano, Fretted (four guitars, Ukulele), Ensembles (four presets) and Your voicings (My 7-String), with Edit voicings… and Done.

shots.page: getting_started: Changing the Sound; playback: Changing Instruments
shots.what: Instrument sheet, first level: the 16 General MIDI families, the current one marked with its instrument on the right.

shots.name: instrument-programs
shots.page: getting_started: Changing the Sound; playback: How to Change Instruments
shots.what: Instrument sheet, second level: the Guitar family's eight instruments with program numbers, Steel Guitar selected, ← back.

shots.name: speed-sheet
shots.page: getting_started: Adjusting the Tempo; interface: The Player
shots.what: Speed sheet at 125%: the value, the 25–400% slider, Reset, Manual… and Done.

shots.name: speed-manual
shots.what: The Manual… speed dialog: a number field (25 to 400) with Cancel / OK.

shots.what: ＋ Insert sheet: Tempo, Time signature, Key, Capo, Label (section), Loop, each with its directive.

shots.what: Insert BPM/Tempo Change dialog: the accepted formats and the BPM field.

shots.name: insert-time
shots.what: Insert Time Signature Change dialog: Beats / Unit pickers.

shots.name: insert-loop
shots.what: Insert Loop dialog: label and count fields.

shots.page: chord_sheet: Suggesting a Capo; directives: Finding the Best Capo
shots.what: Suggest Capo dialog (＋ Insert → Capo → Suggest): pick the fretboard voicing to optimize for.

shots.name: transpose
shots.what: Transpose dialog (whole song): semitones with − / +, Cancel / OK.

shots.what: Chord Identifier (Edit ribbon → Identify): C, E, G and B selected on the keyboard, the Notes field, Possible Chords with Cmaj7 picked, Clear and Insert.

shots.what: Piano roll view: the voiced notes on a keyboard grid, bass in brown, upper voices in blue, the label lane on top.

shots.name: chord-sheet-fret-cards
shots.what: Fret cards view (Guitar Standard voicing): a chord diagram per chord with zoom − / +.

shots.name: chord-sheet-tab
shots.what: Tab view (Guitar Standard voicing): six-line tablature.

shots.name: landscape-play
shots.page: chord_sheet: Showing and Resizing the Strip; interface: Edit and Play
shots.what: Phone in landscape, Play tab: text on the left, the chord sheet and the compact player in the right column, the vertical resize handle between them.

shots.name: landscape-edit
shots.page: interface: The App Bar (phone held sideways)
shots.what: Phone in landscape, Edit tab: the tabs and the Edit ribbon share one line, the title is hidden.

shots.name: edit-keyboard
shots.what: A new song in the Edit tab with the keyboard open, after typing C Am F G (each chord blue).

shots.name: edit-keyboard-collapsed
shots.what: Phone in landscape typing in Edit: the keyboard leaves little room, so the app bar and ribbon hide and the floating Undo / Redo chip sits above the keyboard.

shots.name: tablet-play
shots.page: chord_sheet: Showing and Resizing the Strip; interface: Edit and Play
shots.what: Tablet in landscape, Play tab while playing: text on the left, chord sheet and player on the right.

shots.name: settings-pages

shots.what: Settings › General: font family and size, chord notation, default key, show quick start at startup, number of recent files.

shots.name: settings-playback
shots.what: Settings › Playback: default BPM and time signature.

shots.name: settings-voicings
shots.what: Settings › Voicings on a phone: Add voicing and the custom voicings grouped by model (My 7-String under Fretboard).

shots.what: The voicing form for My 7-String on a phone: Name, Model, Load config, Remove voicing, Strings (B1 E2 A2 D3 G3 B3 E4), Max fret, Fingers, spans…, Save in the top bar.

shots.what: The form of a custom ensemble (Jazz Vocal Trio) on a phone, scrolled to its Voices: the help lines, then one card per voice with Name, Low, High, Staff and ✕.

shots.what: Settings › Voicings on a tablet: the list on the left and My 7-String's form on the right.
